✧ Based on management change, user should provide request benefit in $
✓ Cost saving → Need measurable benefit in $
✓ Efficiency improvement → Need measurable benefit in $
✓ Quality improvement → Need measurable benefit in $

expected_text_blocks.text: ✧ Users should provide below information for management change to issue change request and apply in IT service request system for signoff
✓ Background(Current management, pain point)
✓ Management Change(Improvement Idea)
✓ Benefit
✧ For Fab related:
✧ Based on management change, user should provide request benefit in $
✓ Benefit Approval Procedure
✓ Benefit' <= $100,000(100K) → Need direct manager approval
✓ $100,000(100K)< Benefit < $1,000,000(1M) → Need module head approval
✓ Benefit > $1,000,000(1M) → Need fab head approval
✧ Benefit type
✓ Cost saving → Need measurable benefit in $
✓ Efficiency improvement → Need measurable benefit in $
✓ Quality improvement → Need measurable benefit in $
✓ Customer satisfaction → Need attach related email
✓ Top management strategy → Need attach related email
✧ For Non-Fab related
User should provide the qualitative benefit of requests before submitted to IT<sup>←</sup>
✧ User contact windows should get approval from his/her organization
✧ User should get approval from all relative user organization.
For example, Fab1 DIFF operation request need be approved by Fab7 DIFF.Security
Requirement need be approved by Legal or IT security team.
✧ After user request approved by all relative user contact windows, IT should provide technical solution with resource cost in $ for each request.
✧ For Fab related(Accept request which meet below all items):
✓ Benefit approved by all relative user and management team
✓ IT Solution is feasible
✓ ROI(ROI = Benefit / IT development cost) > 1
✧ ForNon-Fab related
IT will negotiate with user to make the decision by benefit, ROI and IT resource.
✧ For Fab related
✧ Priority = Contribution * Urgent
